article.title: 中國雙11收官，Syntun估主要平台銷售增4.8%
article.summary: 路透引述Syntun估算，中國主要電商平台雙11促銷期銷售額按年升4.8%。
highlights: 淘寶、天貓及京東未公布整體商品交易總額。
article.why: 品牌可用行業估算作參考，再以自家同口徑數據檢查品類、促銷期及購物入口表現。
article.next_step: 對齊今年和去年的活動日數及品類，再核對各入口的訂單及退貨。
article.detail: 路透引述Syntun對主要電商平台的雙11促銷期估算，銷售額按年升4.8%。淘寶、天貓和京東主要披露部分品類、品牌及用戶指標，未公布整體商品交易總額。平台使用了AI購物工具，報道指工具對銷售的貢獻仍未能確定。品牌可把入口、品類及活動日數分開檢視。
article.title_en: Syntun estimates 4.8% Singles' Day sales growth across major Chinese platforms
article.summary_en: Reuters cited Syntun's estimate of 4.8% year-on-year sales growth across major Chinese platforms during the Singles' Day promotion.
highlights_en: The estimate covers October 7 through November 11.
Taobao, Tmall and JD.com did not disclose overall gross merchandise value.
article.why_en: Brands can use the estimate as a reference and compare their own categories, campaign windows and shopping entry points on a consistent basis.
article.next_step_en: Match campaign duration and categories year-on-year, then compare orders and returns by entry point.
article.detail_en: Reuters cited Syntun's estimate of 4.8% sales growth across major ecommerce platforms during Singles' Day. Taobao, Tmall and JD.com highlighted selected category, brand and user figures without releasing overall gross merchandise value. Platforms used AI shopping tools, whose sales contribution Reuters said remained unclear. Teams can review entry points, categories and campaign duration separately.
